svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Reviewer failure path
svg.desc: How a reviewer's untrusted output becomes a fixed category, a saved run file and a red job, and how the run's verdict reaches the posted review.
